newsitem.title: USA: Florida governor holds news conference on Miami.
newsitem.headline: Florida governor holds news conference on Miami.

text.p: Florida Gov Lawton Chiles scheduled a news conference at 1530 EST on Tuesday in Tallahassee to discuss Miami's fiscal crisis, a spokesman said.
Chiles sent other aides to Miami to met with city officials, who were not available for comment.
The governor was expected to appoint an emergency board to take over financial management of the city, which has a $68 million deficit in its budget for the year that began oct 1.
